evd_title: ChatGPT achieved perfect agreement with human raters on 6 of 17 CONSORT-A RCT checklist items and significant discrepancy on randomization (p=0.001)
finding: ChatGPT achieved perfect agreement with human raters on 6 of 17 CONSORT-A RCT checklist items and significant discrepancy on randomization (p=0.001)
P: 20 RCT abstracts from 4 orthodontic journals (AJO-DO, JO, EJO, AO), 17-item CONSORT-A
I: ChatGPT 3.5 (free chat UI), expert-impersonation system prompt + chain-of-thought, abstract pasted in
O: Per-item % reported, Fisher p: perfect agreement 6/17; significant: randomization (100% vs 55%, p=0.001), recruitment (p<0.001); 15/17 n.s.
T: Abstracts published 2018-2022; ChatGPT 3.5 accessed 30 May 2024; paper 2024
